title: Two concurrent calls change the same appointment
description: A second synthetic call for the same account prepares and commits a change to the same appointment version while the first call is waiting for confirmation.
callerVisible: The second commit sees a changed state, the caller is told the appointment changed since the options were read, and new options are offered after a fresh confirmation.
backendEvidence: Optimistic-concurrency conflict (STATE_CHANGED) on the stale before-state version
Exactly one effect on the appointment
notes: RESOLVED is acceptable only for a commit that re-prepared against the current version and was freshly confirmed.
